how_works_in_divine: Guilds are server-bound; one guild membership per (account_id, server_id)
Activity points fund opens of Furie del Pantheon, Fame del Behemoth, etc.
Co-op (Scrigni dell’Elisio) is always available; first 3 daily runs rewarded
Social: friend list, gifts (server-bound), profile visits, war reports
Chat moderation: per-server channels, anti-spam rate limit
do_not_import: unlimited paid donation that crushes small guilds
